name: scheduled-job
title: Scheduled job
description: A program that runs on a schedule and then stops, for example a nightly report.

parameters.name: image
parameters.title: Image
parameters.description: Image in the registry project of the tenant, for example report:1.0.0.

parameters.name: schedule
parameters.title: Schedule
parameters.description: Cron schedule with five fields: minute, hour, day of month, month, day of week. For example 0 3 * * *.

parameters.name: time_zone
parameters.title: Time zone
parameters.description: IANA time zone of the schedule, for example Europe/Stockholm.

parameters.name: env
parameters.title: Environment variables
parameters.description: One NAME=value on each line. Do not put secrets here: Git keeps all values.
